arStrings.szText: Purchased from the Altar of Growth and Decay at the Tree of Whispers.

Summon a Poison Frog Servant that attacks and Poisons enemies for {c_random}{SF_16}{/c} damage over {c_number}{SF_8}{/c} seconds.{if:SF_2} In addition, {c_important}Poison Frog{/c} will pull enemies towards itself and Taunt enemies for {c_number}{SF_10}{/c} second.{/if} On death, the frog explodes violently dealing {c_random}{SF_17}{/c} Poison instantly damage to nearby enemies. This explosion will always Critically Strike.
{c_important}Poison Frog{/c} attacks will pull enemies towards itself and Taunt enemies for {c_number}{SF_10}{/c} second.
